questions.text: Two sides of a triangle are \(20\) and \(21\), and the included angle is \(60^\circ\). Find the third side, then the area.

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.1 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q5
questions.text: Let $P_1(x_1, y_1)$ be the terminal point determined by the real number $t_1 = t$. A sequence of terminal points is generated such that $P_{n+1}$ is determined by $t_{n+1} = \frac{\pi}{2} - t_n$ if $n$ is odd, and $t_{n+1} = \pi + t_n$ if $n$ is even. If $P_1 = \left(\frac{3}{5}, \frac{4}{5}\right)$, determine the exact coordinates of $P_{2024}$.

questions.source_label: Chapter 6.2 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q4
questions.text: The real number $t$ satisfies the inequality $\tan t + \cot t < 0$. If it is also known that $\sec t > \csc t$, determine the quadrant in which the terminal point of $t$ lies.
